programme.title: Kasoor
programme.desc: When Shekhar is accused of killing his wife, he hires Simran, a lawyer with a spotless record. She believes he is innocent and starts developing feelings for him, unaware of his true intentions.

programme.title: Kya Kool Hain Hum 3
programme.desc: A man, kicked out of his house, begins to work as an adult film actor in Thailand. However, things take a turn when he falls in love with a girl from a conservative family.

programme.title: Murder 2
programme.desc: When a slew of sex workers disappear, Arjun, a former police officer, is brought in to crack the case. Subsequently, as he works undercover with Reshma, a young prostitute, she too disappears.

programme.title: No Entry
programme.desc: A gorgeous club dancer's ill-timed rendezvous opens up a Pandora's box of lies, absurdities and misunderstandings in the lives of three quirky couples.
When mobiles start flying from people's hands, Dr Vaseegaran and his robot Nila are asked to help. However, due to Pakshi Rajan having a hand in this, the two have to reinstate Chitti to defeat him.

programme.title: Dil Madharaasi
programme.desc: Heartbroken by a recent split, a troubled individual joins a mission to halt an illegal arms distribution syndicate. Subsequently, he struggles with his painful history to prevent catastrophe.

programme.title: Acharya
programme.desc: On behalf of an idyllic temple town, Acharya takes up the cudgels against a tyrant whose greedy sights are set on the local natural resources.

programme.title: Hai Jawani Toh Ishq Hona Hai
programme.desc: After disagreements over family planning end his marriage to Baani, Jass starts a new romance overseas, only to get caught up in unforeseen secrets and complex relationships.

programme.title: Singh Is Kinng
programme.desc: Happy, notoriously famous for his antics, is sent to fetch Lakhan so that he can meet his ailing father. But, in Australia, Happy ends up taking Lakhan's place as the king of the local underworld.

programme.title: Om Jai Jagadish
programme.desc: Divided by ideologies, yet bound by love, three brothers end up going their separate ways. Fate offers them another chance to be together when their family home is on the brink of foreclosure.

programme.title: Oh My God
programme.desc: After Kanji, an atheist, loses his shop in an earthquake, he decides to sue God. Later, society condemns him for his blasphemy, while Lord Krishna himself becomes Kanji's saviour.

programme.title: Kakuda
programme.desc: Sunny is a resident of Rathodi, a village haunted by a resentful spirit. When a small mistake causes Sunny to be cursed, he approaches a ghost hunter to find a solution.

programme.title: The Bhootnii
programme.desc: After a heartbreak, Shantanu unknowingly summons a spirit named Mohabbat, whose obsessive presence begins to disrupt the peace of the entire college campus.

programme.title: K3 - Kaali Ka Karishma
programme.desc: A young man, who lives happily with his family but is scared of ghosts, visits Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu, with his family. There, he is soon possessed by a vengeful ghost with a sinister past.

programme.title: Aranmanai 4
programme.desc: Suspicious about his sister's death, Saravanan, a lawyer, tries to solve the mystery behind it, only to discover a mysteriously dark force at play.

programme.title: Phone Bhoot
programme.desc: Inspired by stories from their childhood, two young men create a business around capturing ghosts. However, their endeavour turns dangerous when they must fulfil their promise to a poltergeist.

programme.title: Sabdham
programme.desc: A paranormal investigator tackles mysterious university deaths. As evidence mounts, they question their beliefs and confront a possible supernatural threat.

programme.title: Tumbbad
programme.desc: Vinayak Rao, a resident of the village Tumbbad, repeatedly steals the ill-fated wealth of the evil Hastar, until his greed and heinous acts become the reason for his doom.
